snippet.title: Sepulvia - Gameplay Teaser (Old)
snippet.description:
This video is outdated! Updated trailer here: https://youtu.be/qkcwZct3fv4

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5068230/Sepulvia/

Sepulvia is an intimate and insurgent dungeon crawler with a unique perspective on how its turn-based battles approach the themes of death and the grieving processes associated with it. 
 
A strange and edgy adventure for all those who dare not to let go of the rope of hope. Blending mixed media, Sepulvia features a pixel art style with 3D low-poly environments, enhanced by visuals inspired by stop-motion animation and collage. 

Please keep in mind this is a project under development so if you have any feedback feel free to leave it as a comment.

Music by Isla Indigo - Check out their channel for more here:
https://www.youtube.com/@IslaIndigoQ/videos

Get the demo at: https://juhxx-x.itch.io/sepulvia
